channel.title: Rifat Build Notes
channel.description: Short technical notes from MD Rashidul Islam (Rifat) on Python automation, Telegram bots, LLM workflows, and frontend systems.

item.title: How I approach fuzzy search inside a Telegram archive
item.description: Search becomes useful when people do not need to remember an exact title. This note explains the role of normalised text, close matches, and useful metadata.

item.title: Why Termux is part of my engineering practice
item.description: Working across Android and Windows keeps deployment, recovery, and handover questions visible outside a perfect setup.

item.title: The practical layer between a model and a useful product
item.description: An LLM is a component, not the product. Useful prompts, fallbacks, state, and an understandable interface complete the workflow.
